name: Aman-i-Khas Dining Tent
why_it_matters: Aman's Ranthambore camp — lamp-lit communal Dining Tent in the style of Mughal moving-court camps, plus a 20-foot machan platform for private open-fire dinners. The kitchen garden supplies most produce on site.
insider_tip: The machan platform is bookable only by hotel residents and books out at high season — request it at the time of room reservation, not on arrival.
signature_address: Aman-i-Khas, Sherpur Khilji Road, Sawai Madhopur, Rajasthan 322001

name: The Dining Room at Oberoi Vanyavilas
why_it_matters: Hand-painted dining room with Ranthambore-tiger and bird murals on the walls, fireplace seating in the inner hall, courtyard seating around an evening bonfire with live folk musicians. Daily-changing menu of Rajasthani specialities and pan-Indian classics.
insider_tip: Non-residents can dine but the resort takes confirmed bookings only. Skip the lake-and-mango-orchard private setup if you want the live folk music; it only plays in the main courtyard.
signature_address: The Oberoi Vanyavilas Wildlife Resort, Ranthambhore Road, Sawai Madhopur, Rajasthan 322001

name: Khem Villas Dining Room
why_it_matters: Pure-vegetarian dining room run by conservation hosts Goverdhan and Usha Singh Rathore — most produce comes from their organic farm and dairy on the same property. The campfire dinners with the owner are the camp's reputation.
insider_tip: Book a lake-side table at lunch — they set tables out by the camp's natural-restored wetland, and that is the photograph the property is known for.
signature_address: Khem Villas, Village Sherpur Khiljipur, Ranthambore Road, Sawai Madhopur, Rajasthan 322001

name: SUJÁN Sher Bagh Dining Tent
why_it_matters: SUJÁN-run luxury tented camp in the Relais & Châteaux network — a separate dining tent with farm-to-table sourcing and an Indian / anglo-Indian / European menu cooked partly on a tandoor and clay oven. Private dining and starlight setups available.
insider_tip: Ask for the open-fire alfresco dinner at booking, not on arrival — the camp staff need to set up tables outside the dining tent earlier in the day.
signature_address: SUJÁN Sher Bagh, Sherpur, Ranthambhore National Park, Sawai Madhopur, Rajasthan 322001

name: Royal Flavours at The Tigress
why_it_matters: 70-room mid-tier resort 5.9 km from Ranthambore Road — three restaurants under one roof (Royal Flavours, Royal Panorama rooftop barbeque, Royal Beans coffee shop). Useful when the high-end tented camps are out of budget.
insider_tip: The rooftop barbeque is the actual draw — a la carte at Royal Flavours is good but ordinary; ask if Panorama is open before walking in.
signature_address: The Tigress Resort & Spa, Ranthambore Road, Sawai Madhopur, Rajasthan 322021
